changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Numéro, auteur, version courante unique, historique en lecture seule.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document v SET numero = r.n FROM (SELECT id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY document_id ORDER BY created_at, id) AS n FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document) r WHERE r.id = v.id

UPDATE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document v SET courante = (v.id = ( SELECT x.id FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document x WHERE x.document_id = v.document_id ORDER BY x.courante DESC, x.numero DESC LIMIT 1))
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document ADD CONSTRAINT ck_version_document_numero CHECK (numero > 0)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_version_document_courante ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document (document_id) WHERE courante

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document_lecture_seule() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $corps$ BEGIN IF NEW.document_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.document_id OR NEW.numero IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.numero OR NEW.file_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.file_name OR NEW.auteur_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.auteur_id OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at OR (OLD.empreinte IS NOT NULL AND NEW.empreinte IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.empreinte) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Version % en lecture seule : seul son statut de version courante peut changer', OLD.id USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $corps$

CREATE TRIGGER trg_version_document_lecture_seule BEFORE UPDATE ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document_lecture_seule()
